name: Wildrune Bramble Core
description: A rune-marked briar heart hardened by druidic rites.
specialEffects: Used in living armor, thornbound regalia, and root-fastened warding pieces.

steps: Refine raw stock for Wildrune Bramble Core under controlled heat and pressure.
